description: Recordings in monkey V1, V4 and dorsolateral prefrontal cortex for weak visual stimuli (van Vugt et al. 2018, reported by Mashour and colleagues): perceived and unperceived stimuli both drove V1 and V4, but only perceived ones elicited sudden, strong, sustained frontal activity akin to ignition.

sources.quote: only the perceived ones elicited a sudden, strong, and sustained activity in the frontal cortex akin to ignition
